# Binumi

> Binumi is an enterprise communication company that turns an organization's documents, decks, and expertise into on-brand video at scale, pairing an AI video platform with an expert team. The platform is the scale, the service is the expertise, and you buy the outcome, not the tool.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://binumi.com/): Multiply expertise and grow revenue by turning complex knowledge into precision video that wins business, brings workforces up to speed faster, and extends the reach of your experts.
- [Solutions](https://binumi.com/solutions/): Named-client proof across financial services, tech, industrials and more.
- [Industries](https://binumi.com/industries/): Every industry Binumi works with, and the named-client proof.
- [Insights](https://binumi.com/insights/): Strategy, proof and craft on the Static Content Crisis, Systemized Expertise, and the video scaling model behind Binumi.
- [About](https://binumi.com/about/): From cultural storytelling to enterprise communication, why we built Binumi and where it is going.
- [Meet the team](https://binumi.com/meet-the-team/): The leadership team behind Binumi, spanning technology, media, operations and design across Europe, Asia and the US.
- [Contact](https://binumi.com/contact/): Book a demo or start a proof of value with the Binumi team.

## Industries

- [Financial Services](https://binumi.com/industries/financial-services/): Turn complex, compliance-heavy communication into video that earns trust and wins mandates.
- [Professional Services](https://binumi.com/industries/professional-services/): Turn thought leadership, proposals and client communication into video that wins the work.
- [Technology & Software](https://binumi.com/industries/technology/): Turn complex products and dense value propositions into video that shortens the sales cycle.
- [Telecommunications](https://binumi.com/industries/telecommunications/): Turn pricing, propositions and network change into video that acquires customers and reduces churn.
- [Industrials & Manufacturing](https://binumi.com/industries/industrials/): Turn complex projects, safety and bids into video that wins work and aligns every site.
- [Construction](https://binumi.com/industries/construction/): Turn tenders, planning submissions and safety material into video that wins the work and secures consent.
- [Energy & Utilities](https://binumi.com/industries/energy-utilities/): Turn complex projects, safety and change into video that wins approvals and keeps sites compliant.
- [Automotive](https://binumi.com/industries/automotive/): Turn launches, dealer enablement and brand material into video that sells the vehicle across every market.
- [Life Sciences & Pharma](https://binumi.com/industries/life-sciences/): Turn dense data, pipeline stories and medical communication into compliant video that moves investors and partners.
- [Healthcare](https://binumi.com/industries/healthcare/): Turn patient education, clinical training and service communication into video people understand and finish.
- [Real Estate](https://binumi.com/industries/real-estate/): Produce on-brand video for every property, market and audience, faster than the market moves.
- [Travel, Transport & Hospitality](https://binumi.com/industries/travel-transport/): Turn bookings, service change and safety into video that wins customers and aligns operations.
- [Public Sector](https://binumi.com/industries/public-sector/): Turn consultations, services and training into clear video that drives engagement and speeds delivery.
- [Education](https://binumi.com/industries/education/): Turn prospectus, recruitment and learning content into video that wins enrollment and scales teaching.
- [Events](https://binumi.com/industries/events/): Turn every event into months of on-brand video, from pre-event promotion to post-event recaps.
